en: Oh... a visitor. Forgive me, I'm Jasmine, the Leader of Olivine's Gym.
This is Amphy. Its light keeps the ships off the rocks at night, but it's fallen ill and can barely glow.
There's a pharmacy in Cianwood City, over the sea. They make a medicine there that might help, but I can't leave Amphy alone...
If you're going that way, would you... No, I shouldn't ask. Here, take the lift down. It's quicker than the stairs.
Cianwood City is across the sea, west of here. Please, if you find the medicine... Amphy hasn't much light left.
Is that the medicine from Cianwood? Will you let Amphy have it?
Thank you so much. Here, Amphy. Drink it slowly...
Oh! Its tail is shining again! Amphy, you're all right!
I can't thank you enough. Amphy's light will reach the ships tonight.
I must get back to my Gym. Come and see me there. I'd like to battle you, properly, as a Leader should.
Oh... I see. Please don't take too long. Amphy's light is so faint.
Amphy... It breathes weakly, and its tail's light barely glows.
Pa-paloo! Amphy's tail shines bright and steady.
